tep_nay_thuoc_ve: Kho App KH (tuquyduong/APP-KH · Cloudflare · tuquyduong.com) — dat o goc, ngang hang package.json
cach_dung: Nguon su that duy nhat ve tien do App KH. May khong ghi so: chu quan ghi bang script chat soan (kiem dung phien_ban_so truoc khi ghi). Viec phia POS ghi o TIEN_DO_POS.json kho POS.

viec.ten: Dung kho App KH rieng: bo khung tu-chay 1.8.0 chep tu POS 40e07ce, app nen tu app_kh/ POS, demo + dac ta + hop dong /api/kh vao thiet_ke/

Giao dien theo demo cho cac man xem duoc (dang nhap, trang chu, menu, trang mon, uu dai, QR thanh vien, tai khoan, lich su don), PWA, link QR hoa don ?ma=, dien thoai / may tinh bang / may tinh khong vo
viec.ghi_chu: gop PR #1 29.10 (vong 2: khop demo, K9, so anh 72 anh); chat soat dat; chay that tren app-kh.pages.dev

viec.ten: Khach chua dang nhap vao thang Trang chu sau man mo; xem Trang chu, Menu, Trang mon khong can dang nhap; dang nhap / dang ky chi khi can (Uu dai, Tai khoan, ma thanh vien, nhan diem) roi quay ve dung cho; dang nhap / dang ky 3 buoc: SDT → ma Zalo → (khach moi) Ten + Xung ho bat buoc, Dia chi tuy chon
phu_thuoc: POS KH-API-2: /menu khong can token (yeu cau 29.10)

viec.ten: Tien ich chay tren may khach theo demo: Trac nghiem the trang 60 cau + ket qua (luu tren may; gui ban rut gon len POS khi co cua, D4), Ke hoach va nhac viec (lich am, tiet khi, viec cua toi luu tren may — chua thong bao day), 6 tien ich, the video huong dan (an toi khi chu quan gui video)

Man rong >= 1024 px kieu A (giong website thuong hieu): thanh tren co logo + 4 muc, noi dung trai rong, Menu loc ben trai + luoi, mon / QR / don mo dang bang noi — dung NGUYEN thanh phan demo + lop bo cuc man rong, theo mau chu quan duyet (thiet_ke/mau_man_to/)

Noi hop dong v2 (KH-API-2: hang, so du vi, gia tung hang, Gio vang, gio hoat dong + bay_gio) + v3 (TOPPING-1: topping theo mon) + lien he ho tro that + bat o Xung ho / Dia chi o buoc dang ky 3 va Tai khoan (hop dong v2) + tu gia han dang nhap moi lan mo app (khi POS co cua gia han)
Cloudflare Pages noi kho + bien VITE_POS_API + ten mien tuquyduong.com; chu quan dan dia chi vao Cai dat POS (HD-1) ngay 06.11
viec.ghi_chu: 29.10: Cloudflare Pages app-kh (app-kh.pages.dev) da noi kho + VITE_POS_API; con gan ten mien 06.11

viec.ten: May App KH rieng (Render) + kho nho (Turso) + dang nhap kieu so phien thu hoi duoc + khoa dich vu toi POS + chan trang gia + sao luu kho nho (quay lai 10 ngay goi Turso + ban sao hang dem) + dang nhap admin cho che do sua (POS xac nhan tai khoan + quyen)
Phan man hinh dat don: gio, gia that, tra QR payOS / vi + PIN, theo doi don, giao Ahamove, nap vi, mua the hang, doi diem
viec.ghi_chu: dat don giao ma khach chua co dia chi → bat nhap, luu lam dia chi MAC DINH (PUT /toi), co ghi chu cho khach (chu quan chot 29.10)

viec.ten: Man ho so day du con lai (email, gioi tinh, ngay sinh, thong tin hoa don) — xung ho + dia chi da dua len truoc (dang ky 3 buoc, KH-UI-3)
Ma dang nhap qua Zalo ZNS

Thong bao day (Web Push) tu may App KH: dang ky, cac loai tin, cong tac tung loai, tien trinh moi phut (chung nhac viec) + nhan loi nho gui cua POS (POST /internal/thong-bao, khoa dich vu) — dung cho moi danh gia
Chu quan: xin quyen Google Business Profile API (som — duyet vai ngay den vai tuan); lay review link; in QR tai quan tro thang review link tu khai truong (khong can code)

Moi danh gia Google — GIAO DIEN KHACH: the moi Trang chu, Lich su don (Danh gia / Da danh gia), bang truot goi nho, Mo Google, hoi lai khi quay ve; cong tac loai tin 'Moi danh gia' (khi co KH-TB-1). Du lieu + logic o POS (DG-GOOGLE-1)
viec.ghi_chu: sau khai truong; thiet_ke/DANH_GIA_GOOGLE.md (doc ghi chu dau file)

viec.ten: Dot 4 gom: vi gia dinh, nhac viec co thong bao day, luu ket qua trac nghiem len POS, che do sua noi dung, qua sinh nhat, the qua, moi ban
